P_calibration.quote: Corporations cannot be imprisoned, and a default Title 18 fine for an organization is modest relative to the civil exposure; the criminal provision has little bite against the entities it is aimed at

P_holdback.quote: the team may want to decide which items to raise publicly as "unworkable" and which to hold in reserve.

P_grandfather_step.quote: a developer that starts a run (even a trivial number of steps) before enactment can plausibly argue that all subsequent continued training is part of a system whose "training began" pre-enactment, and may deploy it indefinitely.
